properties.label: MIPLIB instance ID
properties.description: Identifier of a problem instance in the MIPLIB mixed-integer programming library

properties.label: MIPLIB tag
properties.description: Classification tag assigned to an instance by MIPLIB, e.g. benchmark, easy, set_partitioning

properties.label: MIPLIB instance group
properties.description: Family of related instances that a MIPLIB instance belongs to

properties.label: MPS file name
properties.description: File name of the problem in MPS format

properties.label: number of implicit integer variables
properties.description: the number of variables that are not declared integer but take integer values in every solution

properties.label: number of fixed variables
properties.description: the number of variables whose lower and upper bounds coincide

properties.label: number of nonzeros
properties.description: the number of nonzero entries in the constraint matrix

properties.label: nonzero density
properties.description: fraction of entries of the constraint matrix that are nonzero

properties.label: objective value
properties.description: value of the objective function in the best known solution

properties.label: MaRDI profile type
properties.description: defines the types of MaRDI profiles expected to work for this item

items.label: MIPLIB instance
items.description: Problem instance from the MIPLIB mixed-integer programming library
